notes.title: Alpha 0.2.1 update
notes.notes:
Hello everybody, we got a minor update today including:

[list]
[*] for those of you who want more precision - sensitivity slider for each axis in control customization panel
[*] for our VR streamers - fullscreen wide 16:9 mirror mode
[*] for our VR players - visible motion controllers in-game with controls mapping drawn over them, you can turn them off in VR menu 
[*] we also fixed page switching in options menu with MC, you can switch pages with left/right grip buttons
[*] Panther "wheels" visuals! ːsteamhappyː
[*] bunch of small fixes
[/list]

GLHF and see you in 2017,
PeopleGottaPlay team

notes.title: Important controls update!
notes.notes:
We've been able to locate the biggest source of frustration with Thick Air controls - lack of stabilization on turning and maneuvering thrusters. The stabilization has been implemented in the latest update and it does wonders to controllability. [b]Thruster stabilization[/b] is turned on by default and you can turn it off anytime you want from the options menu.

[quote]All credit for steering/maneuvering thrusters stabilization feature goes to /r/gamedev community and specifically to /u/nomnaut for taking the time to test and figure out the source of the problem.[/quote]

Another important part of this update is [b]arcade control scheme[/b] (now set as default) - steering and height controls bound to left stick and pitch/roll to right, but one left stick is more than enough to fly at high speeds and make all the crazy turns.

The update is live right now both for the game and the demo. Tell us what you think!

notes.title: Patch notes for 9/20/2016
notes.notes:
We are introducing new flight mechanic - close-to-ground speed up. It makes the race much more dynamic and brings a risk-reward tactic to play - flying low is risky and requires a lot of skill but the speed advantage is invaluable.

Tell us what you think!
